about.title: Personal Injury Help in American Canyon, California
about.longDescription: American Canyon sits along Highway 29 at the edge of Napa County, and its roughly 20,500 residents rely daily on a handful of key corridors — Broadway, American Canyon Road, Rt 29, and Flosden Road — to get to work, school, and the wine country beyond. Public records show 31 injury collisions in the most recent final crash year, leaving 46 people injured and 2 lives lost. Many of these reported crashes cluster on Tuesday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m., a pattern worth noting but not a verdict on any particular stretch of road. If you were hurt in a collision, a fall, or another type of accident here, the aftermath can feel overwhelming: medical bills, missed work, insurance calls. LawProactive is a free service that connects injured people in American Canyon with an independent personal injury attorney — we are not a law firm, and connecting with us costs nothing. Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless they recover money for you. You focus on healing; let someone else worry about the paperwork and phone calls.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before You Wait

items.title: The Clock Is Running
items.desc: California generally gives you 2 years from the date of injury to file a personal injury claim, but claims against a government entity can require notice within 6 months. Missing that window can end your ability to recover anything, so early guidance matters.

items.title: Partial Fault Doesn't Bar Recovery
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly responsible for the accident. Your compensation is simply reduced by your share of fault, not eliminated.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages
items.desc: In ordinary injury cases, California does not limit the amount you can seek for pain, suffering, and other non-economic losses. This matters when injuries affect your daily life beyond just medical bills.

items.title: You Pay Nothing Upfront
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there's no fee unless they win or settle your case. That means you can get legal help without worrying about hourly rates or retainers.

items.question: How long do I have to file a personal injury claim in American Canyon?
items.answer: In most cases, California law gives you 2 years from the date of the injury to file a lawsuit. If your claim involves a government agency, such as a city road defect, the deadline can be as short as 6 months, so it's wise to act quickly.

items.question: What if I was partly at fault for the accident?
items.answer: California uses a pure comparative fault rule, so being partially responsible doesn't prevent you from recovering compensation. Your recovery is simply reduced by your percentage of fault, determined by the facts of your case.

items.question: Where do crashes tend to cluster in American Canyon?
items.answer: Public collision records show higher counts along corridors like Broadway, American Canyon Road, Rt 29, and Flosden Road, with reports tending to peak on Tuesday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. These are neutral counts from public records, not a statement about how safe or unsafe any specific road is.

items.question: Is there a limit on how much I can recover for pain and suffering?
items.answer: No. California does not cap non-economic damages, like pain and suffering, in ordinary personal injury cases. This is different from some medical malpractice claims, which have separate rules.

items.question: Does it cost anything to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service that connects injured people with an independent attorney — we are not a law firm and charge nothing for the connection. Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so you only pay if they recover money for you.
